1420-2178-3967.easyPrerequisites:
Godsire doesn't have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff is attached to Godsire.
1420-2178-3967.description:
Activate Godsire by tapping it, creating a creature token.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Godsire triggers due to its ability granted to it by Thornbite Staff, untapping Godsire.
Resolve the Yahenni ability, Repeat.

1984-2353-4691.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
1984-2353-4691.description:
Cast Angel's Grace by paying {W}, preventing yourself from losing the game this turn.
Draw a card.
Niv-Mizzet triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 3 until your library is empty, preventing a game loss with Angel's Grace.

277-851-1308-4365-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight tapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers.
When the New Planet tokens enter, Tiller Engine triggers eight times, untapping the New Planets.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

1315-3861-6871-7115--44.description:
Cast the artifact by paying {0}.
Toph, Hardheaded Teacher triggers, earthbending Orzhov Basilica.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Zuran Orb by sacrificing Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica dies, Toph, Hardheaded Teach triggers, returning Orzhov Basilica from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Orzhov Basilica enters, it triggers, returning the artifact cast in step 1 from the battlefield to your hand, as it's a land due to Toph, the First Metalbender.
Resolve the Zuran Orb ability
Repeat.

997-4275-5003-7892.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four other Elves that do not have summoning sickness.
997-4275-5003-7892.description:
Activate at least four Elves other than Thranduil by tapping them, adding at least four in any combination of {G} and/or {U}.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Thranduil.
When Thranduil dies, Nim Deathmantle and Faces of the Past trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Thranduil from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Faces of the Past trigger, untapping all Elves and Nobles.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Repeat.

1479-5033-7889.notablePrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
You have a land card in hand that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce at least {1}.
1479-5033-7889.description:
Play any land that enters the battlefield untapped and can tap to produce {1}.
When the land enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Dancing from Dark to Dawn trigger, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers.
Holding priority, activate the land played in step 1 by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Storm Cauldron triggers, returning the land from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting the land from your hand onto the battlefield.
When the land enters the battlefield, Dancing from Dark to Dawn triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat from step 5.

1621-1739-3375-6867.description:
Cast Appa either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {W}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Appa enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Wispweaver Angel with the ability to cast it later from exile.
Cast Wispweaver Angel from exile by paying {0}.
Appa's second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token
When Wispweaver Angel enters, it triggers, blinking Appa.
Repeat from step 2.

141-6798-7682.notablePrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard with mana value 4 or less.
141-6798-7682.description:
Cast Lively Dirge by paying {1}{B} plus an additional {2} to select its second mode, targeting a card in your graveyard.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Lively Dirge.
Holding priority, activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Lively Dirge
Resolve the Lively Dirge copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more loyalty counters on it
as a copy of Aminatou and with two or more loyalty counters on it

193-2724-3194-3908.description:
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Wormfang Manta. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushwing Gryff
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Spark Double's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Aminatou.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Spark Double. Choose to have Spark Double enter as a copy of Aminatou that isn't legendary.
Repeat each turn.

4694-5147-7652.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Tom, Bert, and William.
When Tom, Bert, and William die, they trigger, returning them from your graveyard to the battlefield as a noncreature artifact.
Because Tom, Bert, and William enter as a noncreature artifact, March of the Machines will then cause Tom, Bert, and William to be a 5/5 artifact creature.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

3490-4455-5686-7426.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
3490-4455-5686-7426.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Ghost Lantern triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Berta.
Berta and Animation Module trigger.
Resolve the Berta trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability.
Repeat

1806-2060-2292-6627-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to The Earth Crystal.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

147-5231-6817.description:
Cast Presumed Dead by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, copying Presumed Dead, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the copy of Presumed Dead.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
When Dualcaster Mage dies, it triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

985-2033-5051-5078.description:
Activate Traxos by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Traxos triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.

2942-3011-4090.easyPrerequisites: Each opponent's life total is 2 or greater.
2942-3011-4090.description: Activate Heartless Hidetsugu by tapping it, dealing damage to each opponent equal to 1.5 times their life total, and dealing no damage to you due to Pariah.

3174-5256-5571--6.description:
Donate Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2173-4771-5220-5933.description:
Activate Myr Scrapling by sacrificing it.
When Myr Scrapling dies, Mortuary and Popular Egotist trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Myr Scrapling from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Popular Egotist trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Myr Scrapling ability.
Cast Myr Scrapling from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

478-4002-6871.easyPrerequisites: You control three or more lands that share a name.
478-4002-6871.description:
Activate Sceptre of Eternal Glory by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Candelabra of Tawnos by paying {2} and tapping it, untapping Sceptre of Eternal Glory and Candelabra of Tawnos as they are lands due to Toph.
Repeat.

2232-4284-6749.easyPrerequisites: You control six or more lands.
2232-4284-6749.description:
Cast Clone by paying its mana cost. Choose to have it enter as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
When Clone enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Anticausal Vestige from the battlefield to your hand.
When Anticausal Vestige leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and and put Anticausal Vestige from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Anticausal Vestige enters, Cloudstone Curio triggers, returning Clone from the battlefield to your hand.
When Clone leaves the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to draw a card and put Clone from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Anticausal Vestige.
Repeat from step 2.

618-3580-5231.description:
Cast Lightning Crafter by paying {3}{R}.
When Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Lightning Crafter with haste.
When the token Lightning Crafter enters the battlefield, its champion ability triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki.
Activate the token Lightning Crafter by tapping it, dealing 3 damage to any target.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the token Lightning Crafter.
When the token Lightning Crafter leaves the battlefield, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

3097-3490-4659-4699.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Overgrowth Elemental triggers, causing you to gain 1 life
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers for each counter placed this way.
Resolve the first trigger, choosing to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Resolve all other triggers, choosing not to pay.
Repeat.

1636-1722-5764-6625.easyPrerequisites: You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1636-1722-5764-6625.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Oggyar Battle-Seer by tapping it, causing you to scry 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on it and create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token.
When the Tentacle enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

11-3258-3942-6276.manaNeeded: {2}{U}{U}{U} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
11-3258-3942-6276.description:
Cast Beacon of Tomorrows by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Beacon of Tomorrows.
Holding priority, activate Slick Imitator by paying {1} and sacrificing it, copying Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying the original Narset's Reversal targeting Beacon of Tomorrows, and returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve Beacon of Tomorrows, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Slick Imitator from your graveyard by paying {1}{U}.
Repeat each turn.
11-3258-3942-6276.notes: If you've cast a creature spell using Karador this turn, you may move to your extra turn, and then do step 6 followed by steps 1-5.

186-1812-4222-5516.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls a creature.
Red Death does not have summoning sickness.
Freed from the Real attached to Red Death.
186-1812-4222-5516.description:
Activate Red Death by tapping it, adding {R}, goading a creature an opponent controls and causing that opponent to draw a card.
Activate Prismite by paying {1}, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real by paying {U}, untapping Red Death.
Repeat.

435-5145-5231-5466.description:
Cast Rakdos Joins Up by paying {3}{B}{R}.
When Rakdos Joins Up enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Auratog by sacrificing Rakdos Joins Up.
Resolve the Rakdos Joins Up ability, returning Archon of Falling Stars from your graveyard to the battlefield with two +1/+1 counters on it.
When Archon of Falling Stars enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing Archon of Falling Stars.
Resolve the Archon of Falling Stars ability, returning Rakdos Joins Up from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

225-1308-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
225-1308-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites:
Stone-Seeder Hierophant does not have summoning sicknes.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
225-1308-5702-5954.description:
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Springheart Nantuko and Stone-Seeder Hierophant each trigger twice.
Resolve the first Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger, untapping it.
Holding priority, activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping an Everywhere token.
Repeat from step 4 for the other Stone-Seeder Hierophant trigger.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create two token copies of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods tokens enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 3.

2043-2585-3499-4365.description:
Activate Grim Monolith's first ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Urza by paying {6}, creating two token copies of Grim Monolith that are 1/1 Soldiers in addition to their other types.
Activate both Grim Monolith tokens' first abilities by tapping them, adding six {C}.
Repeat from step 2.

49-2707-4377.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Activate Soldevi Digger by paying {2}, causing you to put Walk the Aeons on the bottom of your library from your graveyard.
Move to your next turn, drawing Walk the Aeons from the bottom of your library due to River Song during your draw step.
Repeat.

513-1741-2792.notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}.
513-1741-2792.description:
Activate up to seven lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{U}{U}.
Cast Great Whale by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Cloud of Faeries to your hand from the battlefield.
When Great Whale enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate up to two lands by tapping them, adding at least {1}{U}.
Cast Cloud of Faeries by paying {1}{U}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Great Whale to your hand from the battlefield.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to two lands.
Repeat.
If you control a land that can tap to produce at least {2}, this combo nets infinite mana.

1486-3525-4289.notablePrerequisites:
Pemmin's Aura attached to Magda.
Magda does not have summoning sickness.
1486-3525-4289.description:
Activate Magda by tapping it, adding {U}.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's first ability by paying {U}, untapping Magda.
Repeat for infinite Treasure tokens.
Once you have infinite Treasure tokens, you can use them to activate Magda's ability to put all artifacts and Dragons in your library onto the battlefield.

141-5067.easyPrerequisites: There is at least one nonland permanent on the battlefield.
141-5067.description:
Cast Release to the Wind by paying {2}{U}
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Release to the Wind, targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the Release to the Wind copy, exiling Naru Meha
Cast Naru Meha from exile without paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 3.

864-957-2334.description:
With Soulherder and a creature based spell recursion effect on the battlefield, cast the extra turn spell.
Move to end step and target the creature with Soulherder's ability.
When creature re-enters the battlefield, target the extra turn spell in your graveyard and return it to your hand, then pass to yourself.
Repeat
